# Dr. Mitch Keil - Keil Psych Group

> > A Newport Beach clinical psychology practice offering evidence-based therapy for anxiety, depression, trauma, and addiction using CBT, psychodynamic therapy, EMDR, and specialized modalities.

Keil Psych Group is led by Dr. Mitch Keil, a clinical psychologist in Newport Beach, Orange County, specializing in multiple evidence-based treatment approaches. The practice serves teens, young adults, and adults with comprehensive mental health services including individual therapy, group therapy, and sports psychology.
